headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 8, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 9-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Meanwhile, the New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Seattle Mariners shortstop J.P. Crawford, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hand contusion. Other notable injuries include Chris Bassitt of the Baltimore Orioles, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list with low back discomfort, and Austin Wells of the New York Yankees, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with cervical headaches.

The Colorado Rockies have bolstered their roster with the addition of shortstop Richie Martin Jr., acquired in a trade with the Texas Rangers. Other notable trades include the Los Angeles Dodgers trading LHP Antoine Kelly to the Chicago Cubs and the Athletics trading RHP Joel Kuhnel to the Milwaukee Brewers for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates dropped a 2-3 decision to the Atlanta Braves in their latest matchup. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Bubba Chandler pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Pirates.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 5-9 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Brandon Marsh leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jonathan Bowlan pitched 2 strong innings for the White Sox, striking out 3 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Cruise Past Red Sox 6-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-1 victory. Jazz Chisholm Jr. led the Red Sox offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Orioles 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 4-6 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Adam Macko earning the win in relief. Taylor Ward led the Orioles' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shortstop J.P. Crawford Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners shortstop J.P. Crawford has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hand contusion, effective retroactive to June 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rockies Acquire Richie Martin Jr. in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies have bolstered their roster with the addition of shortstop Richie Martin Jr., acquired in a trade with the Texas Rangers. Martin Jr. joins the Rockies' lineup, bringing his skills to the team.
